status.title: Current project status
status.description: mvnex is documented here as a source-built CLI for now. Homebrew, winget, and packaged release instructions should be added only when those paths actually exist.
items: Available today: build from source and use mvnex init.
Not documented as available yet: Homebrew, winget, npm, or packaged binary installation.
Next documentation growth: dependency commands, configuration, release notes, and contribution workflow.
